components.name: Sync Service (Confluence ingestion)
components.purpose: Receive Confluence webhook events and run a polling fallback; emit one canonicalised 'page-change' event per (page, source-version) onto the publishing pipeline.
keyPatterns: Webhook deduplication keyed on (page_id, source_version_id)
Polling fallback with a cursor stored in Postgres, triggered by EventBridge schedule
Backoff-on-failure with DLQ for poison events

interfaces.name: POST /webhooks/confluence
interfaces.description: Confluence change webhook receiver; HMAC-verifies the payload and enqueues to SQS.

interfaces.name: page-change SQS message
interfaces.description: Canonical change event consumed by the Publishing Pipeline.

interfaces.name: internal: sync-cursor reader
interfaces.description: Used by the polling-fallback Fargate task to resume after restart.

responsibilities: Verify webhook authenticity and parse Confluence event payloads.
Filter on allow-list (label + space) before forwarding.
Run a periodic poll if webhooks haven't fired in N minutes.
Dedupe duplicate change events.

components.name: Publishing Pipeline
components.purpose: Orchestrate the per-page-change flow: allow-list filter → approval-state check → AI review → render → persist version → invalidate caches → enqueue notification.
components.location: services/publishing (Fargate workers, Temporal-style state machine via AWS Step Functions)
keyPatterns: Step-Functions state machine for retry/visibility
CAS-on-insert for version persistence (idempotent under retry)
Fail-closed on AI Gateway error

interfaces.name: consume page-change
interfaces.description: Reads page-change events from SQS.

interfaces.name: emit publish-complete
interfaces.description: Emitted on EventBridge for downstream consumers (notifications, audit).

interfaces.name: internal: persist version
interfaces.description: Writes immutable version blob to S3 and metadata row to Postgres.

responsibilities: Apply the configured approval-state rule.
Call the AI Gateway for document review; halt on high-severity finding.
Render Confluence storage format to portable HTML with cross-link rewriting.
Persist version metadata + blob; update OpenSearch index; invalidate Redis cache.
Enqueue notification job once publish succeeds.

components.name: AI Gateway
components.purpose: Single mediation surface for every AI call. Owns prompt templates, model selection, fail-closed semantics, audit, and token accounting.
keyPatterns: One narrow tool-shaped operation per AI function (review_page, release_notes, since_last_visit, notification_summary, quality_score)
Per-operation circuit breaker with fail-closed default
Prompt-version stamped on every output for reproducibility

interfaces.name: POST /ai/review
interfaces.description: Document review request; returns findings list or 'provider-unavailable' on failure.

interfaces.name: POST /ai/release-notes
interfaces.description: Release notes generation; returns three-section draft.

interfaces.name: POST /ai/summary
interfaces.description: Generates 'Since your last visit' or per-page notification summaries.

interfaces.name: POST /ai/quality
interfaces.description: Quality scoring (completeness, readability, missing examples, missing API responses).

responsibilities: Build prompts from versioned templates; never inline page content into logs.
Call Amazon Bedrock with the configured Claude model.
Apply the per-operation timeout, retry, and circuit-breaker.
Return a structured 'fail-closed' error if the provider is unavailable or the response fails schema validation.

components.name: Portal API
components.purpose: All authenticated read endpoints for the client portal: browse, read, version history, diff, PDF, search, notification preferences.
keyPatterns: Every request bound to a tenant via session middleware; data-layer rejects untenanted queries
Read-through cache on Redis for hot document versions
Pre-signed S3 URLs for PDF download

interfaces.name: GET /api/v1/products
interfaces.description: Tenant-scoped product/category navigation.

interfaces.name: GET /api/v1/pages/:id/version/:version
interfaces.description: Read a specific version (latest by default).

interfaces.name: GET /api/v1/pages/:id/diff
interfaces.description: Compute a block-level diff between two versions.

interfaces.name: GET /api/v1/pages/:id/pdf
interfaces.description: Generate or fetch a PDF for the requested version.

interfaces.name: GET /api/v1/search
interfaces.description: Tenant-scoped full-text search.

responsibilities: Authn/authz enforcement via Auth Service-issued session tokens.
Compose read responses from Postgres metadata + S3 content + OpenSearch results.
Track per-user last-visited timestamps in Redis (write-behind to Postgres).
Render PDFs on demand via the PDF renderer worker.

components.name: Portal Frontend (Next.js)
components.purpose: Server-rendered client portal at docs.wsd.com — browse, read, version history, search, PDF download, preferences.
keyPatterns: React Server Components for primary read paths (no client JS for static content)
ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) for browse navigation with per-tenant cache key
Accessibility-first component library (WCAG 2.1 AA)

interfaces.name: HTTPS routes (/, /products, /pages/:id, /search, /preferences)
interfaces.description: User-facing routes; all gated by session middleware.

interfaces.name: Server Action: 'mark visited'
interfaces.description: Server-side mutation that updates per-user last-visited via Portal API.

responsibilities: Render the portal UX server-side, hydrating only interactive widgets.
Enforce session presence at edge middleware; redirect to Auth Service login on absence.
Embed AI-generated 'Since your last visit' summary on the landing page.
Drive accessibility (keyboard, screen reader, contrast).

components.name: Auth Service
components.purpose: Login (password + TOTP), session management, optional SAML/OIDC SSO via WorkOS, password-reset, lockout, client-admin user lifecycle.
keyPatterns: Argon2id password hashes; TOTP secret encrypted with KMS-bound DEK
Per-tenant SSO mode flag; password login disabled when SSO is enabled
Token-bound CSRF for cookie-auth endpoints

interfaces.name: POST /auth/login
interfaces.description: Password + TOTP login.

interfaces.name: POST /auth/sso/callback
interfaces.description: WorkOS SAML/OIDC callback handler.

interfaces.name: POST /auth/users/invite
interfaces.description: Client-admin invitation flow.

interfaces.name: POST /auth/logout
interfaces.description: Idempotent logout (clears session in Redis + Postgres + cookie).

responsibilities: Authenticate users and establish/destroy sessions.
Enforce rate limits and account lockouts.
Mediate WorkOS SSO for tenants configured for SAML/OIDC.
Manage tenant-scoped user lifecycle (invite/disable/remove) for client-admins.

components.name: Notification Service
components.purpose: Assemble per-user digest emails (cadence-aware, scope-respecting), generate AI summaries via the AI Gateway, send via SES, honour per-user preferences and reviewer approval for breaking changes.
keyPatterns: Per-user 'last notified high-water mark' for idempotent re-runs
Breaking-change emails sit in 'pending-review' state until approved
One-click unsubscribe links signed with a per-user HMAC

interfaces.name: consume publish-complete
interfaces.description: Reacts to publish-complete from EventBridge.

interfaces.name: cron: cadence batches
interfaces.description: EventBridge schedules daily/weekly digest assembly.

interfaces.name: POST /notifications/preferences
interfaces.description: User-facing preference updates (proxied via Portal API).

responsibilities: Compute the per-user changed-pages set respecting access scope.
Generate per-page summaries via AI Gateway with fallback to title-only.
Send via SES with signed unsubscribe and source = 'email-digest' tracking.
Suppress sends to disabled / removed users.

components.name: Admin UI
components.purpose: Doc-owner and reviewer surface for sync admin, AI review triage, release-notes approval, quality scoring view, unpublish.
components.location: apps/admin (Next.js on Fargate, behind WSD SSO)
keyPatterns: WSD-staff-only access (separate WorkOS connection to WSD's IdP)
All actions audit-logged to QLDB

interfaces.name: HTTPS routes (/sync, /reviews, /notes, /quality)
interfaces.description: Admin surfaces.

responsibilities: Allow doc owners to manage allow-list, re-trigger sync, unpublish.
Allow reviewers to triage AI findings, approve release notes, approve breaking-change notifications.
Surface quality scores and trends per page.

components.name: Audit Log Service
components.purpose: Append-only, tamper-evident audit storage and query API. Backed by QLDB.
keyPatterns: QLDB journal verification (cryptographic digest) on schedule
Read API constrained to security + admin roles
Retention ≥ 12 months; cold-archive to S3 with object-lock thereafter

interfaces.name: consume audit-event
interfaces.description: EventBridge audit-event consumer.

interfaces.name: GET /audit/query
interfaces.description: Security/admin query API for events by actor/tenant/document/date range.

responsibilities: Persist every audit-relevant event with actor, action, target, before/after, timestamp.
Verify journal integrity on schedule and on demand.
Serve compliance queries with SLAs.

components.name: Renderer
components.purpose: Convert Confluence storage format to portable, accessible HTML and on-demand PDF.
keyPatterns: Confluence-storage → AST → portal HTML (deterministic) → PDF (Playwright)
Cross-link resolution against the published-pages index

interfaces.name: POST /render/html
interfaces.description: Called by Publishing Pipeline at persist-version time.

interfaces.name: POST /render/pdf
interfaces.description: Called by Portal API on download.

responsibilities: Faithful structural rendering of headings, lists, tables, code, images.
Cross-link rewriting (live vs 'not available').
Add audit footer (title, version, tenant identity) to every PDF.
